idea-plugin.name: JWT Webhook Signature Timing-Safe Comparison Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on a webhook/HMAC signature comparison that uses .equals()/Arrays.equals() (short-circuits on the first differing byte) instead of MessageDigest.isEqual(...) (constant-time) -- CWE-208, Observable Timing Discrepancy. An attacker can reconstruct a valid HMAC signature byte-by-byte by measuring response times, forging webhook events.

Flags the comparison site inside a method that itself computes an HMAC, recognizing signature-related identifiers by naming convention (sig/hmac/hash/ digest/mac). This pattern is real and widely documented (Svix, Stripe-style HMAC guides, OWASP); webhook-signature-companion (this catalog) verifies that a signature-verification mechanism exists at all -- a different angle from whether the comparison itself is constant-time.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only detects the pattern within the SAME method where both the HMAC computation and the comparison happen -- never follows a signature value passed to another method for comparison. A method already using MessageDigest.isEqual anywhere in its body is assumed already safe.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
